messages:
Nina (AE): Rafael, quick sync after today's presales—wanted to confirm POC asks so we scope properly: Okta IdP, nested groups support, initial CSV bulk import + SCIM deltas, group->role mapping, tenant-level delegated admins, and encrypted audit export. Anything else?

Rafael (Prospect): That's the list. We're running Okta with nested groups, ~80k users, ~12k groups. We need nested group expansion during provisioning and predictable SCIM lag < 20m. Also want support for SSE-KMS to our EU key for exported logs.

Ivy (SE): We can expand nested groups server-side during SCIM sync. For 80k users + nested groups, recommend a short bulk window then steady delta; will request temporary SCIM throughput increase. What's the preferred delta SLA—10m or 20m?

Rafael (Prospect): 20m is acceptable.

Omar (Security): Requirements: SCIM over mTLS, SAML with persistent NameID, groups included in assertion (or via groups endpoint), audit entries with user_id/action/timestamp/IP, retention >= 12 months. We'll also need to review certificate rotation process.

Jen (Legal): If exporting logs to customer S3 with their KMS, we need to update DPA and include export controls + key policy review. Delegated admin scopes must be defined in the contract.

Ivy (SE): Action items: I'll open OPS ticket to provision a Dedicated sandbox and temporary SCIM rate bump. We'll produce a runbook for CSV bulk -> SCIM delta and a sample group->role mapping file.

Nina (AE): Rafael please DM Okta org URL and a sample CSV with nested group paths. Omar and Jen will prepare a short checklist for security and contract asks. Proposed POC timeline: 2 weeks baseline + 1 week scale.

Rafael (Prospect): Sending the CSV now. One quick Q: after cutover, Okta will be source of truth. Do you support soft-delete semantics for users?
Ivy (SE): Yes — we support tombstone/soft-delete during cutover and will include conflict-resolution guidance in the runbook.

Nina (AE): Thanks everyone—I'll collate the checklist and post here by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
